fact: The suspension setup and brake cooling have been changed while under Parc Fermé. Infringment Breach of Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. Decision Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: The setup was modified whilst the car was in parc fermé with the approval of the Technical Delegate further to a written request. The suspension setup and brake cooling have been changed from those previously used in Qualifying. The competitor is therefore required to start the race from the pit lane per article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
